thread:
emma: Postmortem follow-up: the pager avalanche on 2025-01-07. We sketched a few small experiments in the doc. Want to run an "alert-hygiene" sprint next week focused on quick wins (dedupe, thresholds, soft-paging, and a silence playbook). Who can pick what?
noor: I can pick dedupe experiments. Thinking of source-fingerprinting (service+host+error) + a 40s sliding window. Will test in staging first. ETA 6 business days.
ben: I'll do thresholds and retire candidates. My plan: compute per-service p95/p99 over 30d and propose a 2x headroom for spike-prone signals. ETA 4 days.
ops-bot: Incident 2025-01-07: pager-avalanche-retry-loop  520 pages in 5h. Runbook: https://redwood.incidents/2025-01-07-avalanche (auto-attached).
carla: I'll draft the silence playbook and escalation matrix (who can create 1h/6h/24h suppressions and when to escalate). ETA 3 days.
emma: Nice. For paging policy, let's try soft-pages to #alerts for non-SLA events and only pager for Sev0/1. Add auto-escalate after 12m. @carla can you include soft/hard mapping?
noor: Local test config I'm trying:```yaml
alert: http-5xx-spike
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[3m])) by (service)
for: 4m
dedupe_key: "{{service}}:{{host}}:{{error_code}}"
dedupe_window: 40s
```
ben: Query I'm using to rank noisy alerts:```sql
SELECT alert_name, count(*) as fires, percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (value) as p95
FROM alert_fires
WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY alert_name
ORDER BY fires DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
carla: I'll add a short recovery checklist to the playbook: how to rollback rule changes, how to re-enable suppressed alerts, and contact list.
emma: Add everything to the action tracker sheet: https://docs.redwood/pmt/alert-hygiene. We'll convert to JIRA tickets and set labels: action-hygiene, canary, risk-high/med/low.
noor: Putting up PR to add dedupe template to staging tomorrow 09:00 PST, will ping this thread.
ben: I'll attach baseline graphs and a list of candidates to retire in the tracker after my run.
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall sync 2025-01-10 09:00 PST. Agenda item added: alert-hygiene sprint kickoff.
carla: ack, will include the soft/hard mapping and rollback criteria in the draft.
emma: Great work. We'll check progress in the sync and do a one-week post-rollout review to catch regressions. If anyone sees unexpected failures, ping here and we'll rollback immediately. :thumbsup:
